sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment 
inspection I2, which should be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in 
the title block.

Forced draft fan FDF supply air to wind box for firing 
and remove gases from boiler.

The first draft initiated by eng. Kamel Abd El-Salam Abd 
El-Rahman, tested by eng. Mohamed Ahmad Eid, accepted by general manager 
eng. El-Sayed Mohamed Ahmed, approved by eng. Mohamed Abdel Hafez Al-Sharedy: 
head sector of Cairo West Power Station,

 Head Sector, MPIS coordinator.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
Silencer washing (A,B).

Check impeller housings and 
inlet damper guide vanes, blades and linkage for cracks and loose 
connection.
Check the bearing mounting bolts.

Measure the clearance of 
the bearings for radial 
and axial using a lead wire and micrometer.

Change the bearing oil with 
type (DTE 25). figure 2

Carrying out the required 
alignment.

Put FDF (A,B) into 
operation and check vibration.

sections.text: Alignment Procedures

Coupling spacer dismantle 
and remove.

Mount the dial indicators 
one at the axial direction and one on the radial direction both on half coupling 
motor side (fixed part).

Adjust the indicator 
pointer to zero reading.

Rotate the fan on the 
CWD and record the initial reading for axial and radial direction.

Loose the motor mounting 
bolts and jack bolts.

According to the initial 
reading shims to be added or removed under the motor legs to adjust the reading 
to the accepted limits.

تشديد تركيب المحرك 
البراغي والترباس جاك.

Take a final reading for 
the alignment check in the radial and axial direction.

Reassemble the coupling 
spacer.
Put the fan in operation.

Check the vibration using 
the vibrometer.
